name: How long does dry rot repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does dry rot repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of dry rot repair depends on the severity and location of the damage. Small, localized dry rot issues might be resolved within a few days, while extensive structural repairs could take several weeks. Factors like drying out affected areas, the complexity of timber replacement, and necessary structural reinforcements all influence the timeline. For larger projects, coordinating with other contractors or services may also extend the overall project duration, so establishing clear project phases and communication is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage severity, ranging from days for small issues to weeks for extensive structural repairs, factoring in drying and replacement complexity.
